skill.summary: Credential lifecycle security for agent workspaces. Audit credential exposure, detect misconfigured permissions, inventory all secrets, and identify stale credentials needing rotation. Free alert layer — upgrade to openclaw-vault-pro for automated remediation, credential rotation, and access control.
